project.name: eruption-forecast
project.description: Python package for volcanic eruption forecasting that processes raw seismic tremor data, extracts time-series features, trains multi-seed classifier ensembles, and produces probabilistic eruption forecasts.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the dataclass subpackage, re-exporting StationData, SHAP explanation payloads and classifier-ensemble summary dataclasses.

nodes.name: classifier_ensemble_summary.py
nodes.summary: Defines frozen dataclasses (ProbabilityPick, SeedSummary, EruptionWindow, ClassifierEnsembleSummary) that describe per-eruption probability summaries across a classifier ensemble's seeds.

nodes.name: ProbabilityPick
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a single probability pick (datetime, value and index) within an eruption window.

nodes.name: SeedSummary
nodes.summary: Frozen per-seed summary of the highest-probability pick around an eruption.

nodes.name: EruptionWindow
nodes.summary: Frozen per-eruption window record aggregating seed summaries and probability picks for one eruption date.

nodes.name: ClassifierEnsembleSummary
nodes.summary: Mutable container of EruptionWindow records summarising a classifier ensemble's probabilities around every eruption.

nodes.name: classifier_explanation.py
nodes.summary: Defines slotted dataclasses SeedExplanation and ClassifierExplanation holding per-seed and per-classifier SHAP explanation payloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses @dataclass(slots=True) for memory-efficient payloads holding many SHAP arrays.

nodes.name: SeedExplanation
nodes.summary: Immutable per-seed SHAP explanation holding the seed index and shap.Explanation values.

nodes.name: ClassifierExplanation
nodes.summary: Per-classifier SHAP payload bundling SeedExplanation objects, features and metadata for one classifier.

nodes.name: station_data.py
nodes.summary: Defines the StationData dataclass, an uppercased seismic station identity (network, station, location, channel) with derived nslc/nslct strings.

nodes.name: StationData
nodes.summary: Station identity dataclass that uppercases fields in __post_init__ and exposes nslc/nslct identifiers.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the ensemble subpackage re-exporting SeedEnsemble and ClassifierEnsemble; other ensemble classes are deliberately not re-exported to avoid import cycles.

nodes.name: base_ensemble.py
nodes.summary: Provides the BaseEnsemble mixin implementing joblib-based save/load persistence shared by the ensemble classes.

nodes.name: BaseEnsemble
nodes.summary: Mixin providing joblib save(path) and classmethod load(path) for ensemble objects.

nodes.name: classifier_ensemble.py
nodes.summary: Implements ClassifierEnsemble, a container of per-classifier SeedEnsembles with factory loaders (any/json/dict/seed ensembles) and consensus probability, prediction and uncertainty computation.

nodes.name: ClassifierEnsemble
nodes.summary: Wraps multiple SeedEnsembles keyed by classifier; provides from_any/from_json/from_dict/from_seed_ensembles factories, consensus predict_proba/predict and per-classifier uncertainty.

nodes.name: explainer_ensemble.py
nodes.summary: Implements ExplainerEnsemble, the per-seed SHAP TreeExplainer engine that computes ClassifierExplanation payloads in parallel and renders per-seed, aggregate and per-eruption waterfall plots.

nodes.name: ExplainerEnsemble
nodes.summary: SHAP engine over a fitted ClassifierEnsemble: explains each seed with TreeExplainer (skipping non-tree classifiers) and renders seed, aggregate and waterfall plots.

nodes.name: seed_ensemble.py
nodes.summary: Implements SeedEnsemble, an sklearn-compatible classifier bundling all seed models for one classifier, with registry loaders, probability/uncertainty prediction and Parquet matrix caching.

nodes.name: SeedEnsemble
nodes.summary: sklearn BaseEstimator/ClassifierMixin bundling all seed models for one classifier, loading from JSON/CSV registries and caching (n_samples, n_seeds) probability matrices.

nodes.name: explanation_model.py
nodes.summary: Implements ExplanationModel, the pipeline stage that reuses a TrainingModel or PredictionModel to produce cached per-seed SHAP explanations and plots via ExplainerEnsemble.

nodes.name: ExplanationModel
nodes.summary: BaseModel subclass orchestrating SHAP explanation for training or prediction reuse, with content-addressed caching, config snapshotting, explain() and plot().

nodes.name: explanation_plots.py
nodes.summary: SHAP visualisation utilities: per-seed waterfall/beeswarm/bar plots, NaN-padded aggregate bar and beeswarm plots across seeds, and per-eruption classifier waterfalls.

nodes.name: plot_shap_waterfall
nodes.summary: Renders a SHAP waterfall plot for a single sample explanation.

nodes.name: plot_shap_beeswarm
nodes.summary: Renders a SHAP beeswarm plot with plot_size=None to honour a pre-created figure size.

nodes.name: plot_shap_bar
nodes.summary: Renders a SHAP mean-absolute importance bar plot.

nodes.name: render_seed_plot
nodes.summary: Dispatches and saves a per-seed bar or beeswarm SHAP plot to disk.

nodes.name: _aggregate_importance
nodes.summary: Aggregates mean absolute SHAP importance across seeds over the union feature space.

nodes.name: _aggregate_explanation
nodes.summary: Builds a NaN-padded aggregate shap.Explanation by stacking per-seed explanations over the union of features.

nodes.name: plot_aggregate_shap_bar
nodes.summary: Plots and saves the aggregate per-classifier SHAP importance bar chart with a CSV of values.

nodes.name: plot_aggregate_shap_beeswarm
nodes.summary: Plots and saves the aggregate per-classifier SHAP beeswarm across all seeds with CSV export.

nodes.name: _build_explanation_plot
nodes.summary: Builds a single-sample shap.Explanation for waterfall rendering from per-seed SHAP values.

nodes.name: plot_classifier_waterfall
nodes.summary: Renders per-eruption waterfall plots for the highest-probability samples of a classifier using ensemble summaries.

nodes.name: array.py
nodes.summary: Numerical array helpers for tremor cleaning (outlier, z-score anomaly, zero masking, NaN filtering, completeness) plus ensemble probability aggregation and per-seed forecast saving.

nodes.name: save_forecast_seed
nodes.summary: Saves a single seed's forecast probabilities to a CSV file.

nodes.name: compute_model_probabilities
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-seed probabilities into mean probability, uncertainty and confidence arrays.

nodes.name: confidence_interval
nodes.summary: Computes a confidence interval half-width for an array of values.

nodes.name: detect_anomalies_zscore
nodes.summary: Flags anomalous values using a z-score threshold.

nodes.name: mask_zero_values
nodes.summary: Masks zero values in an array, replacing them with NaN.

nodes.name: get_completeness
nodes.summary: Computes the data completeness ratio of an array.

nodes.name: count_valid_values
nodes.summary: Counts non-NaN valid values in an array.

nodes.name: filter_nans
nodes.summary: Removes NaN values from an array.

nodes.name: detect_maximum_outlier
nodes.summary: Detects the maximum-amplitude outlier in a signal using a threshold test.

nodes.name: remove_maximum_outlier
nodes.summary: Removes the detected maximum outlier from a signal.

nodes.name: remove_outliers
nodes.summary: Removes outliers from an array using a selectable method.

nodes.name: formatting.py
nodes.summary: String formatting helpers: slugify utilities, tsfresh feature-name shortening and humanising using frequency-band aliases, and classifier display labels.

nodes.name: _humanize_column
nodes.summary: Converts a tremor column name (e.g. rsam_f2) into a human-readable label with frequency band.

nodes.name: slugify_class_name
nodes.summary: Converts a CamelCase class name into a hyphenated slug.

nodes.name: slugify
nodes.summary: Converts arbitrary text into a lowercase hyphenated slug.

nodes.name: shorten_feature_name
nodes.summary: Shortens a long tsfresh feature name into a compact display form.

nodes.name: humanize_feature_name
nodes.summary: Translates a tsfresh feature name into a plain-English description.

nodes.name: get_classifier_label
nodes.summary: Returns a short display label for a classifier name.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package root that sets up logging and re-exports the public API: tremor calculation, label builders, feature builders, stage models, ForecastModel, decorators and TelegramNotification.

nodes.name: data_container.py
nodes.summary: Defines BaseDataContainer, the abstract base for TremorData and LabelData providing cached filename/basename/filetype properties and abstract date/data accessors.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel for the decorators subpackage, re-exporting the notify and timer decorators.

nodes.name: notify.py
nodes.summary: Implements the @notify decorator that times a wrapped task and sends MarkdownV2-formatted Telegram success or error messages including hostname, elapsed time and exception details.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a functools.wraps-based decorator factory pattern; Telegram MarkdownV2 requires escaping of reserved characters.

nodes.name: timer.py
nodes.summary: Provides the @timer decorator that logs elapsed wall-clock time of a function and optionally forwards it to Telegram.

nodes.name: constants.py
nodes.summary: Constants for label filename prefixes, minimum date range, valid window step units, date format and an example label filename used in validation messages.

nodes.name: label_builder.py
nodes.summary: Implements LabelBuilder, which builds sliding-window binary eruption labels over a date range using day_to_forecast look-ahead, validates inputs, saves label CSVs and config snapshots, and plots label distributions.

nodes.name: label_data.py
nodes.summary: Defines LabelData, a BaseDataContainer wrapper around a label CSV that parses window/forecast parameters from the filename and exposes cached dates, DataFrame and validation.

nodes.name: forecast_model_scenario.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Scenario TypedDict and ForecastModelScenario, which runs tremor calculation once then loops train, predict, evaluate and explain over multiple scenarios with shared stage settings, a scenarios.json manifest and Telegram delivery of forecast plots.
nodes.languageNotes: Scenario uses TypedDict with NotRequired for optional keys, giving typed dict-based configuration.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel for the notification subpackage, re-exporting TelegramNotification.

nodes.name: telegram.py
nodes.summary: Implements TelegramNotification, a fluent Telegram Bot API client for sending messages, documents, photos and media groups with credentials from arguments or .env, logging and swallowing network failures.

nodes.name: label_plots.py
nodes.summary: Plotting utilities for label class distributions, single and multi-scenario comparisons, with file-loading wrapper variants and TypedDict scenario entry specs.

nodes.name: _format_elapsed
nodes.summary: Formats an elapsed duration into a human-readable string for notification messages.

nodes.name: _escape_md
nodes.summary: Escapes Telegram MarkdownV2 reserved characters in plain text.

nodes.name: _escape_pre
nodes.summary: Escapes text for safe inclusion in a MarkdownV2 pre-formatted code block.

nodes.name: _error_message
nodes.summary: Builds the MarkdownV2 error notification with task name, hostname, elapsed time and exception details.

nodes.name: _success_message
nodes.summary: Builds the MarkdownV2 success notification with task name, hostname and elapsed time.

nodes.name: _dispatch
nodes.summary: Sends a formatted message through TelegramNotification and logs failures without raising.

nodes.name: notify
nodes.summary: Decorator factory that wraps a task, measures its runtime, and sends a Telegram success or error notification, re-raising exceptions.

nodes.name: timer
nodes.summary: Decorator factory that logs the elapsed wall-clock time of a function and optionally sends it to Telegram when send_to is 'telegram'.

nodes.name: BaseDataContainer
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for CSV-backed data containers, providing cached filename, basename and filetype plus abstract start/end date strings and data accessors.

nodes.name: LabelBuilder
nodes.summary: Builds sliding-window binary eruption labels from eruption dates and window parameters, with validation, directory setup, CSV persistence, config snapshotting, from_csv loading and distribution plotting.

nodes.name: LabelData
nodes.summary: Wraps a label CSV, parsing parameters such as window step and day_to_forecast from its filename and exposing validated, cached DataFrame and date properties.

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: TypedDict describing one scenario: name, description, training and prediction windows, prediction step and optional plot kwargs.

nodes.name: ForecastModelScenario
nodes.summary: Wraps a ForecastModel to calculate tremor once and run train/predict/evaluate/explain per scenario with shared stage kwargs, slugified output directories, a scenarios.json manifest and Telegram notifications.

nodes.name: _escape_markdown_v2
nodes.summary: Escapes reserved Telegram MarkdownV2 characters in a text string.

nodes.name: TelegramNotification
nodes.summary: Fluent Telegram Bot API client with send_message, send_document, send_photo and send_media_group methods; resolves credentials from args or environment and chunks media groups.

nodes.name: LabelScenarioEntry
nodes.summary: TypedDict describing an in-memory label DataFrame entry for multi-scenario distribution comparison plots.

nodes.name: LabelScenarioFileEntry
nodes.summary: TypedDict describing a label CSV file entry for file-based multi-scenario distribution comparison plots.

nodes.name: plot_label_distribution
nodes.summary: Plots the eruption vs non-eruption label class distribution for a label DataFrame and optionally saves the figure.

nodes.name: plot_label_distribution_from_file
nodes.summary: Loads a label CSV and delegates to plot_label_distribution.

nodes.name: plot_label_distribution_comparison
nodes.summary: Plots side-by-side label class distributions for several scenarios to compare class balance.

nodes.name: plot_label_distribution_comparison_from_files
nodes.summary: Loads multiple label CSVs and delegates to plot_label_distribution_comparison.

nodes.name: constants.py
nodes.summary: Central module of package-wide constants: default tremor methods, frequency bands, 10-minute window duration and sampling frequency, completeness ratio, bandpass corners, under-sampling ratio and the eruption probability threshold.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel for the seismic data sources package, re-exporting the SDS archive reader and the FDSN web-service client.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the SeismicDataSource abstract base class that every waveform source implements via a get(date) method returning an ObsPy Stream.

nodes.name: fdsn.py
nodes.summary: FDSN web-service data source that downloads daily waveforms via the ObsPy FDSN client and transparently caches them in a local SDS archive.

nodes.name: sds.py
nodes.summary: Reader and writer for local SeisComP Data Structure (SDS) archives: resolves daily miniSEED paths, loads and merges streams, and saves downloaded data.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel for the tremor package exposing DSAR, RSAM, ShannonEntropy, TremorData and the CalculateTremor orchestrator.

nodes.name: calculate_tremor.py
nodes.summary: Core tremor orchestrator that reads seismic data day-by-day from SDS or FDSN, computes RSAM, DSAR and Shannon entropy across frequency bands in parallel, merges daily CSVs and plots results.
nodes.languageNotes: Fluent builder API (from_sds/from_fdsn/run returning Self) combined with multiprocessing.Pool for per-day parallelism and cached_property for derived paths.

nodes.name: dsar.py
nodes.summary: Implements the DSAR calculator computing ratios of windowed mean absolute amplitudes between two consecutive frequency-band filtered streams.

nodes.name: rsam.py
nodes.summary: Implements the RSAM calculator that bandpass-filters a stream and computes windowed amplitude statistics (default mean) per frequency band.

nodes.name: shannon_entropy.py
nodes.summary: Implements the ShannonEntropy calculator that filters a broadband stream and computes windowed Gaussian differential entropy as a signal-complexity metric.

nodes.name: window.py
nodes.summary: Windowing utilities for seismic traces: window statistics, daily chunking, per-window metric computation with outlier removal and completeness checks, entropy and sliding-window date construction.

nodes.name: SeismicDataSource
nodes.summary: Abstract base for seismic waveform sources declaring get(date) and a shared log-prefix helper.

nodes.name: FDSN
nodes.summary: FDSN data source that checks a local SDS cache before fetching daily waveforms from a remote FDSN service and saving them back to SDS.

nodes.name: SDS
nodes.summary: SDS archive accessor providing file-path resolution, stream loading and merging, trace retrieval and saving of daily miniSEED files.

nodes.name: CalculateTremor
nodes.summary: Main tremor calculation class: configures station, dates, frequency bands and methods, selects SDS or FDSN source, runs parallel daily jobs, concatenates results and plots tremor.

nodes.name: DSAR
nodes.summary: Computes Displacement Seismic Amplitude Ratio series between two frequency-band streams.

nodes.name: RSAM
nodes.summary: Computes Real Seismic Amplitude Measurement for a frequency band with bandpass filtering and windowed aggregation.

nodes.name: ShannonEntropy
nodes.summary: Computes windowed Shannon (Gaussian differential) entropy of a filtered seismic stream.

nodes.name: get_windows_information
nodes.summary: Extracts sample counts and window counts for a trace given a window duration.

nodes.name: shannon_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes Gaussian differential entropy for a single window of samples.

nodes.name: to_safe_array
nodes.summary: Converts masked arrays into plain float64 arrays with NaN fill for NaN-aware metrics.

nodes.name: chunk_daily_data
nodes.summary: Splits a daily trace into fixed-duration windows, optionally masking zero and NaN samples from dead channels.

nodes.name: calculate_window_metrics
nodes.summary: Applies a metric function over each time window of a trace with optional outlier removal and completeness checks, returning a time-indexed series.

nodes.name: construct_windows
nodes.summary: Builds a sliding-window date grid between start and end dates for a given window step and unit.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the features subpackage that re-exports the experimental FeatureCountSweep class and sweep_feature_count helper.

nodes.name: feature_count_sweep.py
nodes.summary: Experimental post-hoc recommender that sweeps top-N feature counts over persisted per-seed training artefacts, scoring each count with cross-validation to recommend an optimal top_n_features value.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses joblib Parallel/delayed for per-seed fan-out and sklearn clone/get_scorer for estimator-agnostic CV scoring.

nodes.name: feature_selector.py
nodes.summary: Single-stage feature selector supporting tsfresh FDR p-value filtering or random-forest permutation importance, exposing an sklearn-style fit/transform API.

nodes.name: dynamic_label_builder.py
nodes.summary: Label builder subclass that constructs per-eruption sliding-window labels in three phases: zero frames per eruption, concatenate and deduplicate, then mark positives.

nodes.name: logger.py
nodes.summary: Loguru-based logging wrapper providing console/file handlers, per-category error log routing, and enable/disable/level/directory controls for the package.
nodes.languageNotes: Honors the DISABLE_LOGGING env var at import time so worker processes inherit a handler-free logger.

nodes.name: classifier_model.py
nodes.summary: Defines ClassifierModel, an sklearn-compatible wrapper that builds one of 11 classifier estimators with its hyperparameter grid, CV splitter, and slugified output names.

nodes.name: FeatureCountSweep
nodes.summary: Estimator-style sweep over candidate top-N feature counts that fits per-seed CV scores, picks the best count, and supports save/load persistence.

nodes.name: FeatureSelector
nodes.summary: Selects relevant features via tsfresh FDR filtering or random-forest permutation importance with fit/transform/fit_transform and score retrieval.

nodes.name: DynamicLabelBuilder
nodes.summary: LabelBuilder subclass producing per-eruption label windows, deduplicating overlapping datetimes and marking positive windows before each eruption.

nodes.name: ClassifierModel
nodes.summary: Wraps an sklearn/XGBoost estimator with its hyperparameter grid, random state, CV splitter, GPU option, and slug names used for output paths.

nodes.name: sweep_feature_count
nodes.summary: Public entry point that resolves a training run's artefacts and runs a FeatureCountSweep, persisting results and the feature-count curve plot.

nodes.name: _score_fold
nodes.summary: Scores one CV fold for a given feature subset after resampling the training split.

nodes.name: _pick_best
nodes.summary: Chooses the recommended feature count from aggregated scores using a tolerance/parsimony rule.

nodes.name: _resolve_training_context
nodes.summary: Resolves features, labels, and classifier context from a TrainingModel or training directory.

nodes.name: _discover_cv_dir
nodes.summary: Locates the CV-slug features directory inside a training output tree.

nodes.name: _discover_classifier_names
nodes.summary: Discovers trained classifier names from the classifiers output directory.

nodes.name: _harvest_per_seed_inputs
nodes.summary: Collects per-seed selected-feature rankings and fitted models needed by the sweep.

nodes.name: _resolve_forecast_inputs
nodes.summary: Resolves the feature matrix, labels, and classifier inputs for sweep execution.

nodes.name: _persist_sweep
nodes.summary: Writes sweep results to disk and renders the feature-count curve plot.

nodes.name: _category_filter
nodes.summary: Builds a loguru filter routing records bound to a given category.

nodes.name: _uncategorized_filter
nodes.summary: Filter passing only records without a category binding.

nodes.name: _configure_handlers
nodes.summary: Removes and re-registers console, general file, and per-category error handlers.

nodes.name: get_logger
nodes.summary: Returns the shared configured loguru logger.

nodes.name: get_category_logger
nodes.summary: Returns a logger bound to a category so records go to that category's log file.

nodes.name: register_error_category
nodes.summary: Registers a new per-category error log file with level and retention, then reconfigures handlers.

nodes.name: set_log_level
nodes.summary: Changes the console log level by reconfiguring handlers.

nodes.name: set_log_directory
nodes.summary: Redirects log files to a new directory.

nodes.name: disable_logging
nodes.summary: Disables all package logging output.

nodes.name: enable_logging
nodes.summary: Re-enables package logging and restores handlers.

nodes.name: constants.py
nodes.summary: Constants module defining evaluation metric keys, the list of supported classifier codes, and default GridSearchCV hyperparameter grids per classifier.

nodes.name: training_model.py
nodes.summary: Core training stage model that builds labels, extracts tsfresh features, selects features per seed, and fits multi-seed GridSearchCV classifiers, bundling results into SeedEnsemble/ClassifierEnsemble artefacts with content-addressed caching.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends BaseModel; parallelises seeds via the joblib loky backend while clamping inner GridSearchCV workers.

nodes.name: benchmark.py
nodes.summary: Benchmark utility comparing FeatureSelector methods side by side across seeds, measuring selection stability (Jaccard), runtime, and downstream CV scores with plots and CSV outputs.

nodes.name: dataframe.py
nodes.summary: DataFrame helpers for loading label CSVs, datetime-indexed feature matrices, removing tremor anomalies, and computing envelope values.

nodes.name: ml.py
nodes.summary: Machine-learning utility module covering resampling, temporal splits, tsfresh significance filtering, classifier factory, grid search, model registry JSON persistence, threshold metrics, and per-eruption ensemble summaries.

nodes.name: TrainingModel
nodes.summary: Training pipeline stage: build_label, extract_features, and fit multi-seed classifiers with feature selection, resampling, learning curves, ensemble building, and config snapshotting.

nodes.name: _build_training_model
nodes.summary: Constructs a TrainingModel to build labels and features used as benchmark input.

nodes.name: _run_seed
nodes.summary: Runs every FeatureSelector method for one seed: resample, select, time, and score with a ClassifierModel via cross_val_score.

nodes.name: _mean_pairwise_jaccard
nodes.summary: Computes mean pairwise Jaccard similarity of feature sets across seeds as a stability metric.

nodes.name: _write_outputs
nodes.summary: Writes per-seed and summary benchmark CSVs.

nodes.name: _render_plots
nodes.summary: Renders benchmark comparison plots of runtime, score, and stability.

nodes.name: benchmark_feature_selection
nodes.summary: Public entry point benchmarking feature-selection methods across seeds and producing summary tables and plots.

nodes.name: remove_anomalies
nodes.summary: Removes z-score anomalies from tremor columns.

nodes.name: to_series
nodes.summary: Coerces a DataFrame or Series input into a Series for a given value column.

nodes.name: load_label_csv
nodes.summary: Loads a label CSV into a datetime-indexed DataFrame with validation.

nodes.name: load_datetime_indexed
nodes.summary: Loads features and label files and aligns them on a datetime index.

nodes.name: load_features_matrix
nodes.summary: Loads a features matrix (Parquet/CSV) aligned with its label CSV.

nodes.name: get_envelope_values
nodes.summary: Computes rolling envelope (upper/lower) values for a time series.

nodes.name: build_y_true
nodes.summary: Builds ground-truth binary labels from eruption dates over a window grid.

nodes.name: temporal_train_test_split
nodes.summary: Splits features and labels chronologically to avoid leakage.

nodes.name: compute_threshold_metrics
nodes.summary: Computes classification metrics across a range of probability thresholds.

nodes.name: compute_aggregate_threshold_metrics
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-seed threshold metrics into mean/std curves.

nodes.name: random_under_sampler
nodes.summary: Applies imblearn RandomUnderSampler to balance classes.

nodes.name: resample
nodes.summary: Dispatches under/over/auto resampling based on minority-class share.

nodes.name: load_features_resampled
nodes.summary: Loads per-seed resampled features and labels from disk.

nodes.name: get_significant_features
nodes.summary: Runs tsfresh FeatureSelector FDR filtering and returns significant features with p-values.

nodes.name: get_classifier_models
nodes.summary: Factory creating ClassifierModel instances from classifier codes.

nodes.name: grid_search_cv
nodes.summary: Runs GridSearchCV for a ClassifierModel and returns the best estimator.

nodes.name: save_model_json
nodes.summary: Writes the per-classifier trained-model registry JSON of seed models and features.

nodes.name: compute_seed
nodes.summary: Computes per-seed predictions and metrics for an ensemble seed model.

nodes.name: build_classifier_ensemble_summary
nodes.summary: Builds a ClassifierEnsembleSummary of per-eruption probability windows and picks.

nodes.name: constants.py
nodes.summary: Defines shared column-name constants (id, datetime, is_erupted), seconds-per-day, and the default set of tsfresh calculators excluded from feature extraction.

nodes.name: features_builder.py
nodes.summary: Implements FeaturesBuilder, which runs per-column tsfresh feature extraction over windowed tremor matrices in training or prediction mode, caches Parquet outputs, and merges them into a unified features matrix.

nodes.name: tremor_matrix_builder.py
nodes.summary: Implements TremorMatrixBuilder, which slices tremor time-series into label-aligned windows, validates per-window sample counts, and concatenates them into a single id/datetime-indexed matrix (optionally saved per tremor column).

nodes.name: base_model.py
nodes.summary: Abstract base for all stage models (training, prediction, evaluation, explanation) providing tremor loading, date/directory resolution, label and feature building, config saving, and a content-addressable cache with hashed identities and dual-mode save/load.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses abc.ABC with abstract methods, functools.cached_property, and hashing of canonicalized identity dicts for cache keys.

nodes.name: forecast_model.py
nodes.summary: Top-level ForecastModel orchestrator chaining calculate, train, predict, evaluate and explain stages, capturing each stage kwargs into a ForecastConfig for save_config/from_config/run replay with cache-aware stage reuse.
nodes.languageNotes: Fluent method chaining where every stage method returns Self.

nodes.name: prediction_model.py
nodes.summary: Implements PredictionModel, which loads a trained ClassifierEnsemble, builds an unlabelled forecast window grid, extracts (or loads) features, computes per-classifier and consensus eruption probabilities, and plots the forecast with cache identity tied to the training hash.

nodes.name: FeaturesBuilder
nodes.summary: Extracts tsfresh features per tremor column in training (label-filtered) or prediction mode, with feature exclusion, cached-matrix reuse and Parquet merging.

nodes.name: TremorMatrixBuilder
nodes.summary: Builds windowed tremor matrices aligned with label windows, validating sample counts and saving combined and per-method matrices.

nodes.name: BaseModel
nodes.summary: Abstract stage-model base with tremor/date handling, label and feature extraction helpers, config snapshotting, and hash-based cache identity with save/load.

nodes.name: ForecastModel
nodes.summary: Pipeline orchestrator exposing calculate/train/predict/evaluate/explain stage methods, config capture, from_config factory, and run() replay.

nodes.name: PredictionModel
nodes.summary: Stage model that forecasts eruption probabilities over an unlabelled window grid using a trained ensemble, writes results tables, and plots the forecast.

nodes.name: tremor_data.py
nodes.summary: Defines TremorData, a BaseDataContainer wrapper around a tremor CSV exposing cached properties for the DataFrame, columns, date range and day count, plus sampling-rate consistency checks.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the utils package re-exporting label-filename parsing and the core validation guard functions.

nodes.name: date_utils.py
nodes.summary: Date helpers for converting values to datetime, normalizing and sorting date lists, parsing label CSV filenames into parameters, and coercing DataFrames to a DatetimeIndex.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.overload to declare multiple signatures for sort_dates.

nodes.name: feature_utils.py
nodes.summary: Feature-list utilities for loading curated or aliased feature sets, maintaining ranked top-features CSVs, concatenating per-seed significant features, finding common features, and merging tsfresh features matrices.

nodes.name: validation.py
nodes.summary: Centralized guard functions validating random states, date ranges, window steps, required DataFrame columns, and time-series sampling consistency.

nodes.name: TremorData
nodes.summary: Tremor CSV container exposing cached DataFrame, column, date range and n_days properties with sampling consistency validation.

nodes.name: to_datetime
nodes.summary: Converts strings, dates or timestamps to a datetime object with consistent parsing.

nodes.name: sort_dates
nodes.summary: Sorts a list of dates (overloaded for string or datetime outputs), optionally returning formatted strings.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md. It describes eruption-forecast as a Python package that processes raw seismic tremor, extracts time-series features, trains multi-seed classifier ensembles and produces probabilistic volcanic eruption forecasts. It lays out the CalculateTremor-to-ExplanationModel pipeline and the SDS/FDSN data sources that the rest of this tour follows stage by stage. The wiki Home page is the navigation hub for the detailed workflow guides referenced later.

tour.title: Running the Pipeline
tour.description: main.py is the reference end-to-end script: it chains ForecastModel's calculate, train, predict, evaluate and explain stages over a list of known eruption dates. forecast-scenario.py is the second entry point. It runs tremor calculation once, then loops shared training, prediction and evaluation over several Scenario dicts. The Pipeline-Walkthrough wiki page annotates both workflows and shows what each stage contributes.

tour.title: The ForecastModel Orchestrator
tour.description: Every stage in main.py goes through ForecastModel, which chains calculate, train, predict, evaluate and explain and captures each stage's keyword arguments into a hierarchical ForecastConfig. That captured config lets save_config(), from_config() and run() replay a full experiment from a YAML file. ForecastModelScenario wraps one ForecastModel so the expensive tremor calculation runs only once across many scenarios.
tour.languageLesson: Method chaining (a fluent interface) works because each stage method returns self, typed as typing.Self. You can then write fm.calculate(...).train(...).predict(...) as a single expression while the object builds up state.

tour.title: Seismic Data Sources
tour.description: The first stage needs waveforms. SeismicDataSource is an abstract base class with one get(date) method that returns an ObsPy Stream. SDS reads a local SeisComP archive, and FDSN downloads daily data from a web service and caches it transparently in a local SDS archive. Because both share one interface, the tremor stage does not need to know where the data comes from.
tour.languageLesson: Python's abc.ABC with @abstractmethod defines an interface that subclasses must implement. Instantiating a subclass that leaves get() undefined raises TypeError, which catches incomplete data sources early.

tour.title: Calculating Seismic Tremor
tour.description: CalculateTremor pulls the stream for each day from a data source and computes three metrics across frequency bands in parallel. RSAM is the windowed mean amplitude per band, DSAR is the ratio between consecutive bands, and Shannon entropy measures broadband signal complexity. It merges the daily results into a 10-minute tremor CSV, and TremorData wraps that CSV with cached properties so later stages can read it.

tour.title: Building Eruption Labels
tour.description: Supervised learning needs targets. LabelBuilder slides a time window over the date range and marks a window positive (is_erupted=1) when an eruption falls within the next day_to_forecast days. DynamicLabelBuilder builds per-eruption windows in three phases. LabelData wraps the resulting label CSV and parses the window parameters back out of its filename, matching how TremorData wraps the tremor CSV from Step 5.

tour.title: Features from Tremor Windows
tour.description: TremorMatrixBuilder slices the tremor time series from Step 5 into windows aligned with the labels from Step 6 and checks that each window has the expected number of samples. FeaturesBuilder runs tsfresh extraction on each tremor column and caches the results as Parquet. FeatureSelector then keeps only the informative features, using either tsfresh's FDR p-value filter or random-forest permutation importance.

tour.title: BaseModel and Caching
tour.description: Each pipeline stage model inherits from BaseModel. It handles tremor loading, date and directory resolution, and a content-addressable cache: a hash of the stage parameters and a tremor fingerprint names the pickle file, so a repeated run with the same inputs loads from disk instead of recomputing. Each stage also writes its settings to a YAML config through a dataclass that shares stamping and dict round-tripping from BaseConfig.
tour.languageLesson: Content-addressable caching derives the cache key from a hash of the inputs, such as a sorted JSON dump of the parameters. Any change to the parameters produces a different key, so stale results are never reused and no manual invalidation is needed.

tour.title: Multi-Seed Training
tour.description: TrainingModel puts Steps 6 and 7 together. It builds labels, extracts features, then selects features and fits a GridSearchCV classifier for each of many random seeds. ClassifierModel wraps the 11 supported estimators and their hyperparameter grids. utils/ml.py provides the resampling, grid search and model-registry helpers.

tour.title: The Ensemble Stack
tour.description: The per-seed models from Step 9 are stored in two layers. SeedEnsemble is an sklearn-compatible classifier that bundles every seed model for one classifier and returns probabilities with uncertainty. ClassifierEnsemble holds one SeedEnsemble per classifier and computes consensus predictions. BaseEnsemble supplies the shared joblib save and load methods. ClassifierEnsemble is one of the most imported modules in the package, so this stack connects training to the prediction, evaluation and explanation stages.
tour.languageLesson: SeedEnsemble subclasses sklearn's BaseEstimator and ClassifierMixin. Implementing fit, predict and predict_proba with those mixins lets a custom class work with sklearn utilities that expect a standard classifier.

tour.title: Producing Forecasts
tour.description: PredictionModel loads a trained ClassifierEnsemble, builds an unlabelled grid of windows over the forecast period and extracts features the same way as in training. It then computes eruption probability, uncertainty and confidence for each classifier and for the consensus. Its cache key includes the training hash, so retraining automatically invalidates old forecasts. forecast_plots.py draws the probability-over-time figure with eruption markers.

tour.title: Evaluating Ensembles
tour.description: EvaluationModel scores a pre-trained ensemble against ground truth and never refits it. It runs in two modes: training reuse takes labels from the TrainingModel, and prediction reuse rebuilds labels over the forecast grid from known eruption dates. MetricsEnsemble computes probability and prediction matrices with one column per seed, plus aggregate ROC, PR and threshold metrics. ClassifierComparator ranks classifiers against each other.

tour.title: Explaining Predictions with SHAP
tour.description: The last stage asks why the ensemble predicted what it did. ExplanationModel reuses a TrainingModel or PredictionModel, and ExplainerEnsemble runs SHAP TreeExplainer for each seed in parallel. It covers tree classifiers only (RF, lite-rf, GB, XGB) and skips the rest with a warning. The results are stored as SeedExplanation and ClassifierExplanation dataclasses and drawn as bar, beeswarm and per-eruption waterfall plots.
tour.languageLesson: Dataclasses declared with slots=True store their fields in fixed slots instead of a per-instance __dict__. That saves memory when you hold one explanation object per seed across hundreds of seeds.

tour.title: Shared Infrastructure
tour.description: A few modules support every stage above. logger.py, a Loguru wrapper with per-category error logs, and utils/pathutils.py, which handles output directories, figure saving and data I/O, are the two most imported files in the codebase. date_utils.py normalises dates and parses label filenames. The Output-Structure wiki page shows the station-level directory tree for each stage.

tour.title: Architecture Recap
tour.description: Finish with the Architecture guide, which connects the package layout, the BaseModel hierarchy and the ensemble stack covered in this tour. The package __init__.py re-exports the public API (tremor calculation, label and feature builders, stage models and ForecastModel), so it summarises what users are expected to import. Use the API-Reference page for full details of every class you have now seen in context.
